# Data Ownership Table — OMP Studio Presentation Boundary

**Generated by Phase 13 boundary revision.** This table is the authoritative source for
which data classes cross into which renderer, with what gate, persistence, and audit
treatment. Any change to this table requires a Phase 13-style revision with the
same verification rules.

| Data Class | Wire Type | Owner | Gate | Persistence | Audit Granularity | Exclusions Applied |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Existing (Phases 1–6)** |
| Bootstrap config | `StudioBootstrap` | Studio Server | Cookie session | Durable | Per-session (startup) | No OMP session path, no provider secrets |
| Workspace metadata | `StudioWorkspace` | Studio Server | Cookie session | Durable | Per-workspace (register/remove) | No absolute paths |
| Model selection | `StudioModelSelection` | Studio Server | Cookie session + lease | Durable | Per-session (change) | No provider credential IDs |
| Session summary | `StudioSession` | Studio Server | Cookie session + lease | Durable | Per-session (lifecycle) | No OMP session ref, no raw tool data |
| Run lifecycle | `StudioRun` | Studio Server | Cookie session + lease | Durable | Per-run (state transitions) | No native failure payload |
| Transcript message | `StudioTranscriptMessage` | Studio Server | Cookie session + lease | Durable | Per-message (append) | No raw provider response, no tool output |
| Activity entry | `StudioActivityEntry` | Studio Server | Cookie session + lease | Durable (bounded per session) | Per-event (projection) | No native tool name, args, output, path |
| Tool display | `StudioToolDisplay` | Studio Server | Cookie session + lease | Durable | Per-tool-card (projection) | No native tool name, args, output, path |
| Plan summary | `StudioPlanSummary` | Studio Server | Cookie session + lease | Durable | Per-run (projection) | No task text, no raw todo data |
| Change file | `StudioChangeFile` | Studio Server | Cookie session + lease | Durable (snapshot) | Per-workspace (on demand) | No absolute paths, no raw Git output, bounded diff |
| Approval | `StudioApproval` | Studio Server | Cookie session + lease | Durable | Per-approval (request/resolve) | No raw arguments, argumentsDigest only |
| Subagent | `StudioSubagent` | Studio Server | Cookie session + lease | Durable | Per-subagent (state changes) | No OMP session ref, no raw tool data |
| Usage | `StudioUsage` / `StudioUsageHistoryEntry` | Studio Server | Cookie session + lease | Durable | Per-run (aggregation) | No provider cost breakdown |
| Provider metadata | `StudioProvider` | Studio Server | Cookie session | Durable | Per-provider (onboarding) | **No credential IDs, paths, secrets** |
| Auth progress | `StudioAuthProgress` | Studio Server | Cookie session + flow ID | Ephemeral | Per-flow (phase transitions) | Sensitive values redacted in sanitizer |
| Audit entry | `StudioAuditEntry` | Studio Server | Cookie session + lease | Durable | Per-control-plane action | Browser-safe `detail` fields only |
| **New (Phase 13 — Track C)** |
| Terminal session metadata | `StudioTerminalSession` | Studio Server (PTY owner) | `OMP_STUDIO_DESKTOP` env + dedicated cookie scope | Durable | Per-session (create/destroy/resize) | No PTY bytes, no raw shell env, no cwd outside workspace |
| Terminal output chunk | `StudioTerminalOutput` | Studio Server | `OMP_STUDIO_DESKTOP` env + dedicated cookie scope | **Ephemeral** (streaming only, not persisted) | Per-chunk (byte budget enforced) | Chunk size capped; no scrollback persistence |
| Terminal resize | `StudioTerminalResize` | Desktop Shell → Studio Server | `OMP_STUDIO_DESKTOP` env + dedicated cookie scope | Ephemeral | Per-resize (user action) | — |
| Browser tab metadata | `StudioBrowserTab` | Desktop Shell (WebContentsView host) | `OMP_STUDIO_DESKTOP` env + IPC-only for agent commands | Durable | Per-tab (lifecycle) | No cookies/storage, no raw page content |
| Browser navigation | `StudioBrowserNavigation` | Desktop Shell → Studio Server | `OMP_STUDIO_DESKTOP` env + IPC-only for agent commands | Durable (audit only) | Per-navigation (every URL audited) | Agent commands never reach browser client |
| Browser screenshot | `StudioBrowserScreenshot` | Desktop Shell | `OMP_STUDIO_DESKTOP` env + size-capped REST (≤512 KiB) | **Ephemeral** (not persisted) | Per-screenshot (bounded artifact) | Size cap enforced; no full page HTML |
| Browser agent grant | `StudioBrowserGrant` | Desktop Shell | `OMP_STUDIO_DESKTOP` env + IPC-only channel | Durable | Per-grant (grant/revoke) | Take-over is immediate; profile switch revokes all |
| Voice turn (transcript) | `StudioVoiceTurn` | Studio Server | `OMP_STUDIO_DESKTOP` env + dedicated cookie scope | Durable | Per-turn (transcript projection) | Follows existing transcript rules; no audio |
| Voice audio buffer | `StudioVoiceAudio` | Desktop Shell (renderer capture) → Studio Server (STT) | `OMP_STUDIO_DESKTOP` env + dedicated cookie scope + IPC-only | **Ephemeral** (discarded after STT unless explicit save) | Per-buffer (discard or explicit save) | Never persisted by default; explicit save = user action |
| Workflow graph | `StudioWorkflowGraph` | Desktop Shell (authoring) | `OMP_STUDIO_DESKTOP` env + dedicated cookie scope | Durable | Per-graph (author/execute) | Amends workbench non-goal list |
| Workflow node | `StudioWorkflowNode` | Desktop Shell / Studio Server (execution) | `OMP_STUDIO_DESKTOP` env + dedicated cookie scope | Durable | Per-node (state projection) | Per-node state via existing inspector pipeline |
| Workflow edge | `StudioWorkflowEdge` | Desktop Shell | `OMP_STUDIO_DESKTOP` env + dedicated cookie scope | Durable | Per-edge (graph structure) | Semantics projected, not raw DSL |

**Gate Legend:**
- `Cookie session` = standard `omp_studio_session` cookie (browser + desktop)
- `Lease` = control lease (`holderId`) required for mutating operations
- `OMP_STUDIO_DESKTOP` env = process env var set only by Electron main when spawning sidecar; **stronger than `features` flag** because browser client never has it
- `Dedicated cookie scope` = separate cookie name/prefix (`omp_studio_desktop_*`) issued only to desktop shell windows
- `IPC-only channel` = Electron `ipcMain`/`ipcRenderer` channel with no WebSocket/REST equivalent; browser client has no access
- `Size-capped REST` = response body hard-limited; 413 if exceeded

**Persistence Legend:**
- `Durable` = written to Studio SQLite, survives restart, replayed on reconnect
- `Ephemeral` = streaming only, not persisted, not replayed; may have in-memory buffer with byte budget
- `Ephemeral (discard or explicit save)` = discarded by default; only persisted on explicit user action

**Audit Granularity Legend:**
- `Per-session` = one audit entry per session lifecycle event
- `Per-event` = one audit entry per projected event
- `Per-run` = one audit entry per run state transition
- `Per-chunk` = audit entry per streaming chunk (with byte budget to prevent flood)
- `Per-user-action` = audit entry only on explicit user actions (grant, take-over, save)
- `Per-workspace` = audit entry on workspace-scoped operations
- `On demand` = audit entry only when explicitly requested (e.g., change review)
